clips.title: The story
paras: Along the Wetlands crossroads, Einar Stonegrip keeps to the road and sends his goods to town with travelers. He avoids Menethil Harbor, where his estranged wife lives.

Einar Stonegrip hunts crocolisks where the roads meet in the Wetlands. The crossroads link Dun Algaz, Dun Modr, and Menethil Harbor. He sells their sturdy hides to leatherworkers and merchants along the coast. Though rugged enough to wrestle reptiles from the mire, Einar is embroiled in a bitter falling-out with his wife, Sida. He stays on the road and asks travelers to carry his bundles of skins to his trading partner, James Halloran, rather than enter Menethil Harbor himself.
